rankingsCopy.lead: Logged boss kills on Forever, ranked by DPS and HPS for each spec, class, ruleset and guild. The companion uploads your combat log as you play, so your kills join the board.
rankingsCopy.description: World of Warcraft: Forever rankings by encounter: characters, guilds, specs and phases.
rankingsCopy.openReport: Open the kill in its report

rankingsEmptyCopy.boardFill: Upload a log with the kill and it ranks here.
rankingsEmptyCopy.guildsAnywhere: No guild has a ranked boss kill yet.
rankingsEmptyCopy.guildsFill: A guild ranks once a member uploads a log of the kill.

encounterPickerCopy.heading: Encounters
encounterPickerCopy.noneYet: No boss kills are ranked yet.
encounterPickerCopy.fill: A boss gets its board when the first log of its kill is uploaded.
encounterPickerCopy.topNone: No ranked kill on this board yet.

homeTopGuildsCopy.empty: No guild has a boss kill logged yet.

scoreCopy.heading: Forever Score

components.label: Gear
components.moves: How close your gear is to your spec’s best set for your level (20, 30, 40, 50 or 60).

components.label: Experience
components.moves: 25 for each different dungeon cleared and 40 for each different raid boss killed, across your main and the alts the site has linked to it.

components.label: Parses
components.moves: How your best damage or healing on each boss ranks against others of your spec, averaged over the bosses you have killed.

components.label: Attendance
components.moves: How many of your guild’s raid nights in the last 90 days you were in the log for.

components.label: Preparation
components.moves: Flask, food and enchants on every logged pull: the share of your logged fights you started with all three.

scoreCopy.caption: [fn]
scoreCopy.experienceCounts: 25 points a dungeon, 40 a raid boss, up to 700.
scoreCopy.historyCaption: Forever Score by date, oldest first
scoreCopy.notFoundNewCharacter: Lookup only finds characters someone has already brought to Forever Sixty, and Blizzard publishes a brand-new one only after it is played and logged out. If this is yours, sign in with Battle.net: all your characters are listed straight away, new ones too.
scoreCopy.knownYours: Is this your character? Sign in with Battle.net and it opens as yours, with its gear and talents.
scoreCopy.notFoundSignedIn: Your own characters are in the character menu at the top of the page.
scoreCopy.notFoundNowhere: Not on any other ruleset or region either.
scoreCopy.noLogsHint: Log a raid with the companion and the score fills in.
scoreCopy.noLogsOwner: The companion uploads your fights automatically.
scoreCopy.inGameShownOn: Shown on this character’s tooltip when you have the Forever Sixty addon.
scoreCopy.inGamePlannerLead: This page updates by itself each time you log out with the addon and the companion running. Without the companion: /fs copy in game, then
scoreCopy.inGamePasteLink: paste it on the setup page
scoreCopy.explainerScoreCaption: Forever Score: your whole record, 0 to 2,100.
scoreCopy.explainerLaunch: Parses, attendance and raid bosses count once raids open.
scoreCopy.tiersNote: The tiers take the colours of item quality.
scoreCopy.explainerLogsHeading: How to get your logs here
scoreCopy.explainerLogsBody: The companion uploads your combat log as you play.

ratingCopy.parseVsRating: A parse is your rank against other players; the rating is how well the fight was played.
ratingCopy.trendTableCaption: Performance Rating by fight, oldest first
ratingCopy.panelEmpty: No ratings for this fight yet.
ratingCopy.tabEmpty: No ratings for this fight yet. Ratings are computed after a report finishes processing, and some encounters do not have a curated table yet.
ratingCopy.noRatingForTrash: Ratings come with boss kills in raids.
ratingCopy.flagged: This report is flagged and not rated.
ratingCopy.nightNotOnePull: Ratings are one pull’s. Pick a boss pull from the list to see one.
ratingCopy.enemiesHaveNone: Ratings are for your raid, not the enemy.
ratingCopy.noMatchingRow: This player has no rating for this fight.
ratingCopy.absoluteBasis: Measured against the encounter’s own numbers: not enough logs yet to compare players.
ratingCopy.threatNotModeled: Threat: not modeled yet. It does not count for or against Utility.
ratingCopy.cappedNote: capped from a higher weighted average: a costly avoidable death outweighs the rest of the fight. See Survival.
ratingCopy.cappedRule: An avoidable death early in a fight caps the overall score at 40, because nothing else in the fight makes up for it.
ratingCopy.characterEmpty: Nothing rated yet. Ratings appear after your first ranked fight.

components.body: Damage, or effective healing, against what the fight allowed with your gear.
Avoidable deaths, an early one costing most, and avoidable damage taken.
Interrupts, dispels, and debuffs carried that should have been cleansed.
Uptime of the buffs and debuffs your class keeps up for the raid.
Flask, food, oil or stone at the pull, potions in the fight.
Time spent casting or swinging, scripted downtime left out.

parts.gear: Your gear against your spec’s best set for your level
parts.experience: 25 a dungeon cleared, 40 a raid boss killed, alts included
parts.parses: Your best boss parses against your spec
parts.attendance: Your guild’s raid nights logged in the last 90 days
parts.discipline: Flask, food and enchants on every logged pull

copy.adjustable: Defaults; guild officers can change them

rules.title: Ranked
rules.body: With at least 20 kills of the same encounter, difficulty, spec, role and kill speed logged, a component is ranked against players of your spec in those logs: "better than 71% of Fury Warriors on this fight."

rules.title: Absolute
rules.body: With fewer, a component is measured against the encounter's own numbers. A new boss or an unmatched kill speed starts here and moves to ranked at 20 comparable logs (fast, typical or slow, against the encounter's own kill times).

rules.title: Wipes
rules.body: A wipe scores Survival and Mechanics only. Output, Utility, Preparation and Activity are left out: a wipe's damage window is cut short.

rules.title: A part left out
rules.body: A component that cannot be scored for a fight is named and its weight goes to the ones that did: an encounter with no mechanics table yet, a spec the simulator does not model yet, too few logs to compare.

fns.boardEmpty: No Fury Warrior kills on Warden Kelthas yet.
fns.noneYet: No boss kills are ranked yet.
